summary: Android EAS deploy-readiness light smoke test (iter 15). All 8 requested checks are GREEN. google-services.json present at /app/frontend/, is valid JSON in Firebase client-config shape (project_info + client + oauth_client + api_key), and contains NO service-account markers (no 'type':'service_account', no 'private_key'). Package identifiers match end-to-end: app.json expo.android.package == google-services.json client[0].client_info.android_client_info.package_name == 'com.swasthdaily.app', and expo.ios.bundleIdentifier == 'com.swasthdaily.app'. app.json expo.android.googleServicesFile == './google-services.json' (relative path resolves correctly at frontend root). google-services.json is NOT gitignored (neither /app/.gitignore nor /app/frontend/.gitignore matches it; the *-firebase-adminsdk-*.json and serviceAccountKey*.json patterns only target service-account JSONs). expo-notifications plugin is declared in app.json plugins with icon/color/defaultChannel config. Backend smoke test: GET /api/ -> 200 ({message:'Online Vaidhyaji API',version:'1.0'}), admin login (admin@vaidhyaji.com / Admin@123) -> 200 with valid JWT (185 chars, role=admin), POST /api/register-push with {device_token, platform} -> 201 {'status':'pending','note':'push key placeholder'} (graceful placeholder-key handling working). Frontend loads at http://localhost:3000 with 0 JS errors, 0 pageerror events; only benign warnings (expo-notifications web push-token listener not supported, deprecated 'shadow*' style props). Home screen renders correctly ('Online Vaidhyaji', symptom checker, book vaidya, medicine reminders, home remedies visible). Deploy-readiness: GREEN across the board.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Cosmetic web-only dev warning; no runtime impact on native Android/iOS build. Not a deploy blocker.

1_google_services_json_valid.detail: File exists at /app/frontend/google-services.json, valid JSON, has project_info + client + oauth_client (empty [] but present) + api_key. No 'type':'service_account' or 'private_key' keys.

4_not_gitignored.detail: grep 'google-services' in /app/.gitignore and /app/frontend/.gitignore -> NO matches. File will be committed and included in EAS upload.

7_backend_smoke.detail: GET /api/ -> 200; admin login -> 200 with JWT; POST /api/register-push (with device_token+platform) -> 201 {status:'pending'} (graceful placeholder key).

8_frontend_loads.detail: http://localhost:3000 -> HTTP 200; title='frontend'; 0 JS errors, 0 pageerrors; home screen renders as expected.

critical_code_review_comments: google-services.json contains an empty oauth_client:[] array — this is fine for FCM push (no Google Sign-In configured). If Google Sign-In is later added, an OAuth client will need to be registered in Firebase console.

Backend register-push contract requires field name 'device_token' (not 'expo_push_token'). Verified the frontend usePushNotifications hook already sends 'device_token' — no mismatch. Just flagging for clarity.
